newsitem.title: USA: MobileMedia holders file class action suit.
newsitem.headline: MobileMedia holders file class action suit.

text.p: Attorneys representing a pension plan that bought shares of MobileMedia Corp stock said plaintiffs filed a class action suit against the company.

The suit also names as defendants the company's former chief executive Gregory Rorke; former chairman and acting chief executive David Bayer; Michael Lorelli, who just resigned as chief executive on Nov. 19; and former president and chief operating officer John Kealey.
The company said it had no comment on the lawsuit.
"We have not been served. I cannot comment on something we haven't seen," a spokeswoman said.
